title: PUT /presence has no local-admin or write gate
description:
Spec 18.5.2 treats PUT coap://[node]/presence as set-own-presence. Peer operations are GET/Observe. PresenceResource.render_put accepts any CoAP client with a valid CBOR map.

Impact:
- A mesh peer can overwrite another node's advertised status, msg, battery, and ts.
- A peer can PUT status=emergency without the SOS origin-signature path (spec 18.4.1).
- Observe subscribers are then fed attacker-chosen presence documents (amplification / false emergency).

Sibling resources already gate writes: ConfigResource defaults allow_writes=False (4.01), SentMessagesResource requires _peer_is_local_admin.

File: python/src/lichen/coap/resources/presence.py render_put

This is not LCI access.py (out of scope); the resource itself needs a write gate (local-admin, allow_writes, or equivalent OSCORE-bound check).
acceptance_criteria: Unauthenticated/non-local PUT returns 4.01. Local-admin or explicitly enabled writes still return 2.04. GET/Observe from peers remain allowed.
close_reason: PUT /presence now rejects unauthenticated writes with 4.01 unless allow_writes=True or local-admin loopback; GET/Observe remain public. Tests cover both gates.
